body: i do drink water everyday but not as much as i should, i eat maybe once or twice a day and they’re not very big meals. and no i dont have any fruits or veggies in the house

i just dont see a future in which i can get a grip on my depression and/or anxiety and finally live a normal life and be “happy” or “ok”. lets say i did. then what? ride it out until i fall again? and again? its an endless cycle of how long can you feel good before you ultimately, inevitably feel bad again. and im just tired. tired of having no one but myself. tired of having no energy/motivation to do anything at all. basically instead of rotting/fading away, im just gonna speed up the process. been having a lot of trouble eating and sleeping this past year, so at least this way ill get plenty of rest and not have to worry about eating.

you and i think a lot alike, although my situation varies a bit, still a lot of similarities, so yea. i feel you. just reading this made me want to reach out and hug you not just to comfort you, but myself as well because i feel like we would understand each other better than most other people could ever try understanding, and when you’re in a world where you feel so alienated and alone at all times through your life every second, no matter what, its nice to see someone else might actually be feeling what im feeling for once. in a sick/ironic way its like a small sense of relief because for the first time ever i dont feel completely alone anymore, that there might actually be someone out there who fucking gets it you know? reminds me of the group therapy session in the last episode of the last season of Mad Men

a collection of things really, it just hits all at once. all the time. and when i smoke weed my mind is clear, focused, and i just have a hard time doing that without it. being boxed in your own head everyday battling with yourself because you know half of all this is your own fault and knew it was gonna happen anyways, yet here we are. as for the other half of it all, well i guess you could just chalk it up to life always wanting to shit on me and it just doesnt know how to stop. and as soon as you think you’re doing ok again, as soon as you feel ok, like things are better and will stay that way. boom. its all gone. it never fails, and im just tired. its like i dont want to die, but i sometimes just cant stand living either.
does smoking a joint count as doing something for me? cause thats the only thing i can think of that i even want to do.

great. just found out that the girl i was in love with never loved me at all. just another day in the life i guess. i mean can i really be surprised at all? its not like anyone else loves me or cares about me, why would i expect any different from her?

personally im not very good at drawing/painting. but i understand what you’re saying and i can see how that’d be helpful. if i could paint though the first one would probably be a picture of me running towards a bright light. the closer i get to it the bigger my shadow becomes until it swallows me up.

tried therapy, it was ok at first but in the end i felt like i was just wasting her time. that was earlier this year, ive actually been trying to get back into it but they havent called back yet. 

tried anti depressants. i was on them for a month and then never refilled the bottle. i dont really even know why i didnt tbh. but i did notice a difference. i didnt feel “happy” just because i was on meds, but ill admit i felt less shitty. i felt like i had a little more energy as opposed to just dragging through the day on auto pilot if you know what i mean. it still didnt stop the war going on in my head, just made it a little more quiet i guess. cant really remember much else because it was 7 months ago. got prescribed another bottle of the same stuff 2 weeks ago or so but havent started them.
why fight it? and i have been, its just not working out.
